description: This file is a shell script that contains a comprehensive set of tests for Git's handling of the untracked cache feature, including status commands, cache dumping, invalidations, sparse checkouts, and worktrees with symlinks and file replacements.

methods.name: sync_mtime
methods.description: Synchronizes modification time of all directories in the current directory.

methods.name: avoid_racy
methods.description: Introduces a sleep delay to avoid race conditions.

methods.name: status_is_clean
methods.description: Checks if the Git working directory is clean.

methods.name: test_lazy_prereq
methods.description: Tests for the presence of the untracked cache prerequisite.
